name: GRIP Dataset
summary: 面向可变形与刚体耦合抓取的通用机器人增量势接触仿真数据集。
summaryEn: A robotic incremental-potential contact simulation dataset for coupled deformable-rigid grasping.
scale: Released Finray subsets contain 100-frame simulated grasp trajectories; other subsets follow the release plan
scaleZh: 已发布 Finray 子集包含每条 100 帧的仿真抓取轨迹；其他子集以发布计划为准
access: Project page and official repository available
accessZh: 项目页和官方仓库可用
verdict: 用于接触动力学和耦合物体状态预测的抓取数据
verdictEn: Grasping data for contact dynamics and coupled object-state prediction
wmNote: 物理接触状态与动作序列支持可解释动力学学习。
wmNoteEn: Contact states and action sequences support interpretable dynamics learning.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - BeLl0o/GRIP_Dataset: [IROS 2025] Official repository of GRIP: A General Robotic Incremental Potential Contact Simulation Dataset for Unified Deformable-Rigid Coupled Grasping. · GitHub
evidence.statement: Official HDF5 schema explicitly contains 100-frame grasp trajectories with time-varying joint states, object mesh states, contacts and friction forces. Only currently released subsets count as available.
